newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Ingosstrakh to insure Tokobank property.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Ingosstrakh to insure Tokobank property.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurer SAO Ingosstrakh and 19th biggest bank Tokobank on Friday signed a contract to insure the bank's Moscow real estate.
Tokobank president Vyacheslav Khokhlov told a news conference that the contract was worth several million dollars, but refused to mention the exact sum.

He said the contract included insurance of two major Tokobank buildings in Moscow -- its headquarters in the south of the capital and the newly-built Tokotower on the Moscow River embankment near the White House.
Ingosstrakh already has real estate insurance contracts with 12 Russian banks, over 21 Moscow offices of foreign banks and Russian state banks abroad.
